title: THIS WEEK: EU leaders clash over budget cuts, Sánchez risks losing power, and Putin invites EU to dinner
lede: Thursday's EU summit could be the last one for Spanish prime minister Pedro Sánchez, as his socialist PSOE party polls behind the centre-right PP ahead of snap elections on Sunday.

title: Hundreds of methane leaks uncovered in Europe, as Brussels delays monitoring crackdown
lede: Infrared cameras exposed hundreds of methane leaks across seven EU countries, as capitals lag on enforcing the rules and the EU prepares to delay them.
